title: Presidential Candidates Face Hectic Schedule This Thursday (3)
subtitle: Interviews, religious gatherings, and social project visits highlight candidates' busy day
excerpt: This Thursday (3), presidential candidates are set for a full day of interviews, public question-and-answer sessions, meetings with religious leaders, and visits to social institutions.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Thursday, March 3rd, presidential candidates are set for a series of engagements across various media outlets. The planned activities include interviews and public question-and-answer sessions, expected to be broadcast on television stations and media platforms, enabling candidates to present their proposals directly to the electorate.

Meetings and Visits

In addition to their media appearances, the agenda includes meetings with religious leaders, strengthening the relationship between candidates and various faith communities. Visits to institutions and social projects are also planned, where presidential hopefuls can observe community impact projects firsthand.

Campaign Activities

Rounding out the schedule, candidates are expected to engage in leaflet distribution and the formal presentation of their electoral programs. These actions are complemented by party activities, which are part of the strategy for mobilizing support and disseminating proposals throughout the campaign.

With information from Agência Brasil.
